stage.name: null-clock-primary-v2
stage.question: Does the complete verified-null configuration merit independent confirmation against accepted production choices?

resourceQualification.limits: Prospective availability screen, not isolation or a bound on short bursts; endpoint memory only. No outcomes used.
resourceQualification.protocol: null-clock-development-v2: at most2.0 other average logical CPUs; paired delivery and actor checks required

actorDelivery.limits: Native process CPU includes startup, JIT, GC and idle protocol handling; this coarse screen complements pre/post owner-thread delivery and host checks, not proof of isolation.

statistics.method: Fixed sample opening-pair mean; pair-variance normal approximation (only n>=30, nonzero variance), plus conservative bounded-pair Hoeffding alpha=.05. No acceptance inferred.
